title: Porto, September 2024
summary: Three-night trip with a relaxed pace. Porto felt smaller and easier to explore than larger cities, with strong food, river views and compact neighbourhoods.
whatWorked: Ribeira, Cedofeita and Baixa were easy to connect on foot.
River views and short scenic walks gave the trip a strong sense of place.
Cafes, wine bars and casual restaurants suited a flexible itinerary.
A slower pace made the hills manageable.
whatDidNotWork: Rain made some cobbled streets slippery.
A short stay left little room for a bad-weather day.
Some restaurant areas became busy at predictable evening times.
weatherNotes: Best when mild and dry enough for walking. Rain is manageable if the itinerary includes indoor food halls, cafes and galleries.
futureRecommendation: Porto is a strong fit for a compact, relaxed trip. It is less ideal if heavy rain is forecast for most of the stay because the best moments are outdoors and on foot.
